tagline: Global leader in biopharmaceuticals and diagnostics innovation
hero_kpi_rationale: Roche is a global leader in biopharmaceuticals with massive R&D investments, making it a key driver of structural growth and differentiated innovation in the healthcare sector.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (as % of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development spending in total revenue.
kpis.description: Roche dedicates a major portion of its revenues to R&D, reflecting its internal innovation model and leadership in biologic medicines.
kpis.signal: Very high R&D level, typical of innovative biotech leaders.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, measured as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high thanks to strong value-add from flagship products such as Herceptin and other targeted therapies.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical of biotech companies with strong pricing power.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is declining slightly due to increased sales and marketing costs, particularly on new product launches.
kpis.signal: Slight pressure on operating margin despite solid gross margin.

kpis.name: Total Headcount (in thousands)
kpis.description: Roche continues to add talent, primarily in research, diagnostics, and novel cell therapy areas.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth, aligned with R&D and diagnostics expansion.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (manufacturing plants and R&D)
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for production sites and R&D facilities.
kpis.description: CAPEX is increasing to support new production centers in Switzerland and the United States, particularly for gene therapies.
kpis.signal: Significant CAPEX increase, focused on new biopharmaceutical production capacity.

kpis.name: Recurring Revenue (subscriptions and maintenance contracts)
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenues from maintenance contracts and connected diagnostics.
kpis.description: Roche is developing digital diagnostics platforms with integrated software subscriptions, generating more predictable revenue.
kpis.signal: Growth in recurring model from digital diagnostics.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 9.8 CHF in latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 7.731 billion CHF in latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 60.0% in latest year.

kpis.name: AI API Call Volume (billions)
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to AI APIs integrated in digital diagnostics platforms.
kpis.description: Roche uses AI for interpretation of histological images and genomic data via its NAVIFY and DeepLens platforms.
kpis.signal: Explosion in AI adoption for medical data analysis.

kpis.name: Share of contracts including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud contracts that include artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: Roche systematically integrates AI modules in its cloud offerings for hospitals and laboratories.
kpis.signal: AI is becoming standard in diagnostics cloud solutions.

ai_positioning.summary: Roche is integrating AI into its digital diagnostics and drug discovery platforms, not as a core business unit but as a lever for efficiency and precision. The focus is on AI applied to healthcare, particularly for genomic data and medical imaging analysis.
evidence: Use of AI in the NAVIFY platform for predictive patient journey analysis
Integration of AI APIs in DeepLens digital pathology tools
Partnerships with AI startups in oncology and neurology
